senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="S02183">same</cite> Targ. II Esth. I, 2 <he>תרנגולין מְקַרְקְרִין</he> the cocks (on Solomon’s throne) crowed.—
units: <cite ref="Chullin 53a:16">Ḥull. 53ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>איהו … ואינהו קמְקַרְקְרָן</he> when he (the lion) roars, and they (the domestic animals) make a noise (mow, bleat &c.).
